answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies leverages scarcity-based identity where each agent must stake a unique, computationally expensive "marble" token. This mechanism ensures the verifiable "lotus" of identity blossoms only through genuine resource commitment, safeguarding the network's trust "summit".
